data.long_meaning: The name Bisnu is derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'one who is blessed with happiness and prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, Bisnu is the god of preservation, who protects the universe and restores balance and order. The name Bisnu carries the meaning “Blessed with happiness and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bisnu usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with happiness and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_sanskrit.name: विस्नु
